items.title: Migrate decision-doc quorum trigger to unified review escalation policy
items.context: Migrate the hard DONE policy from direct decision-doc file-change quorum to a unified review-escalation predicate. Keep decision-doc change detection for diagnostics, add first-review countable-problem evaluation, and make machine DONE consume the new policy rather than blocking every documentation edit. Include host verdict identity/binding fields needed by the quorum predicate.
items.userSees: User sees zero-finding decision-doc audit reported as not requiring review escalation quorum, while threshold-triggered stories still block without quorum.

happy.desc: A direct decision-doc change with zero first-round countable findings does not require host verdict quorum and can pass DONE after normal validation/delivery gates.
Two verified critical/high/medium reviewer findings in the first REVIEW round set requires3x2=true and make missing quorum block DONE.

edge.desc: Suspected, disproven, non-reviewer, and low-severity findings do not count toward the first-round escalation threshold.

adversarial.desc: Stale material verdicts, duplicate host/session/key verdicts, FAIL, and BLOCKED verdicts do not satisfy full 3x2 quorum.

verificationEvidence.note: Final smoke passed: ordinary documentation audit changes do not require escalation by themselves and report ordinary review unless first-round countable findings trigger escalation.
Final smoke passed: two first-round verified reviewer problems trigger review escalation and full 3x2 can satisfy it when independent hosts are present.
Final smoke passed: suspected, disproven, low severity, non-reviewer, and later-round findings do not trigger escalation.
Final smoke passed: stale material, duplicate identity, and non-pass host verdicts fail closed and do not satisfy full quorum.

items.title: Add or update smoke coverage for documentation audit trigger cases
items.context: Prove zero-finding decision-doc changes do not require 3x2 after migration, first-review threshold findings still require quorum, degraded 3x1 behaves as lower assurance, and old hostId-only verdict handling does not regress existing quorum diagnostics.
items.userSees: User sees review-escalation smoke tests pass for zero-finding, threshold-triggered, and degraded 3x1 cases.

happy.desc: Smoke test proves direct decision-doc edit with no countable first-round finding is classification-only and not a quorum blocker.
Smoke test proves two countable first-round reviewer findings trigger full quorum requirement.

edge.desc: Smoke test proves explicit degraded 3x1 fallback can pass only with allowed reason, evidence/approval, fresh material, and lower-assurance result.

adversarial.desc: Smoke test proves missing fallback evidence or attempts to label degraded review as full 3x2 fail closed.

verificationEvidence.note: Final review escalation and decision-doc quorum smokes passed; zero-finding decision-doc edits remain classification-only, not quorum blockers.
Final smoke passed: two countable first-round reviewer findings trigger the review escalation requirement.
Final smoke passed: explicit degraded fallback passes only as assuranceLevel=degraded-single-host with fresh material and evidence or approval.
Final smoke passed: missing fallback evidence or stale material remains blocked and degraded review is never reported as full 3x2.

items.title: Update operator-facing diagnostics and docs to avoid false always-on claims
items.context: Ensure decision_doc_quorum_check, review_escalation_status, and DONE gate messages describe documentation-audit classification, first-review escalation triggers, degraded-single-host assurance, and current Authority boundaries without claiming every decision-doc edit still requires 3x2.
items.userSees: User sees English diagnostics that explain whether review escalation is not required, full 3x2 is required, or degraded 3x1 was accepted.

happy.desc: review_escalation_status reports not-required, required full-3x2, blocked, pass-full-3x2, and pass-degraded-3x1 states in English.

edge.desc: decision_doc_quorum_check reports documentation-audit classification without claiming every decision-doc edit requires quorum.

adversarial.desc: Diagnostics never set or imply authorityDone, fullAuthorityDone, receiptVerified, productionDone, or full-3x2 for degraded review.

verificationEvidence.note: Final CLI output reports required=true, ok=true, assuranceLevel=degraded-single-host, three valid single-host rounds, fullQuorum.ok=false, and Authority completion flags false.
Final CLI output says changed decision docs do not by themselves require DONE quorum and points operators to review_escalation_status for the actual DONE requirement.

verificationEvidence.command: rg degraded Authority/full-3x2 overclaim scan in changed decision docs plus review_escalation_status
verificationEvidence.note: Final docs scan found only negative or boundary statements around degraded review; live review_escalation_status reports authorityDone=false, fullAuthorityDone=false, productionDone=false, and fullQuorum.ok=false.

items.title: Register review-escalation quorum facts in the process-fact contract
items.context: Because this story changes DONE-gate consumed facts, update process-fact registry, process-fact levels, command policy, CLI surface checks, and the process-fact contract verifier so docs, handlers, and gates cannot drift silently.
items.userSees: User sees process-fact contract verification pass for the new review escalation runtime facts.

happy.desc: Process-fact contract verifier passes and covers review_escalation_status, review_escalation_fallback_set, host verdict identity fields, and DONE gate consumption.

edge.desc: review_escalation_status remains read-only and fallback/host verdict writes are gate-evidence metadata writes with no Authority overclaim.

adversarial.desc: Contract verifier fails if the new commands or gate-consumed facts are missing from CLI, policy, levels, or registry.

verificationEvidence.note: Final process-fact contract passed and includes review_escalation_status, review_escalation_fallback_set, autopilot_review_submit host verdict evidence, and runtime:review_escalation_done_gate.
Final verifier confirms review_escalation_status is L0 read-only while fallback and host verdict writes remain L4 metadata gate evidence with no Authority overclaim.
Final verifier retains hard assertions for CLI schema, command policy, level registry, artifact registry, gate consumers, and host verdict semantics.

items.title: Implement explicit degraded 3x1 review-escalation fallback
items.context: Add runtime support for approved degraded single-host review only when fallback eligibility, allowed reason, evidence or approval, fresh material binding, and lower-assurance reporting are present. It must never be reported as full 3x2 or Authority receipt completion.
items.userSees: User sees degraded 3x1 accepted only as degraded-single-host and never as full 3x2.

happy.desc: A required escalation can pass degraded 3x1 only with explicit allowed reason, eligibility path, evidence/approval, three fresh single-host rounds, and assuranceLevel=degraded-single-host.

edge.desc: Single-host rounds without allowed fallback reason and evidence/approval remain blocked.

adversarial.desc: Degraded 3x1 cannot be reported as full-3x2, two-host independent, or Authority receipt completion.

verificationEvidence.note: Final smoke and live status passed: explicit degraded 3x1 fallback has allowed eligibility, approval/evidence refs, current material binding, three single-host rounds, and assuranceLevel=degraded-single-host.
Final smoke passed: single-host rounds without allowed fallback reason and evidence or approval remain blocked.
Final smoke and live status passed: degraded 3x1 has fullQuorum.ok=false and authorityDone/fullAuthorityDone/productionDone all false.
